label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
To: docs/climate-programme/border-revenues-launch/handover
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Handover: border revenues launch, Thursday 26 November

Inês,

I am sorry to do this to you. My father is ill, I am with my family, and I am taking the train tonight. I don't know how long I'll be away, and I won't be at the launch on Thursday. You will be doing it instead, and I want you to hear this from me: I trust you completely with this paper and with the event. You know the work as well as I do. You ran the annex B sensitivity runs yourself, and I could not have done them without you.

I also have to own a mistake. Figure 3 and the summary used the wrong 2030 revenue figure. The correct number is EUR 1.4 billion, not EUR 2.1 billion. I only found it this afternoon. The error is mine, not yours. If anyone asks, say so plainly: it was my error in the old run, I found it, and it's corrected. The conclusion of the paper does not change. The headline number does, and that needs fixing before Thursday.

Everything you need is in this folder and in my inbox. Below is what to do, in order.

1. Badges and the panel change. Tomás Reyes in Lindqvist's office needs the final names of everyone from our side by Wednesday 25 November, 12:00 at the latest, or security will not let them in. You are taking my place on the panel, so put yourself on the list and tell Tomás directly that I've been replaced. His email from this morning also changed the timings. The presentation is now 15 minutes, not 20. The panel starts at 12:50, not 12:55. The MEP has a vote and must leave at 13:30, and she wants to take at least two questions herself before she goes. Ask Tomás on Wednesday who moderates once she has left, and agree the running order with him in writing. The run of show from 20 November is still in the folder, but these changes override it.

2. Fix the numbers. PDF v7 on the drive is corrected (pages 3, 14 and 15). Do not use any older PDF or printed copy. The deck (v4, 14 slides) still shows 2.1 on slides 6 and 9. Slide 9 has the revenue chart. Please update both, and check my speaker notes too, because I wrote them before I found the error. Check every number against PDF v7.

3. Correct the press release. Hanna sent the embargoed release to our 34 Brussels contacts on Friday. It says 2.1, and the embargo lifts Thursday 26 November at 10:00 CET. A corrected version needs to go to the same list, clearly marked as a correction, before the press calls on Wednesday and well before 10:00 on Thursday. Please talk to Hanna first thing on Wednesday. If she thinks the correction needs a senior name, Geert knows I'm away and has agreed he can sign it off. Call him if you need him. Don't wait for me.

4. Press calls on Wednesday 25 November, at 14:00 and 15:00. These are background phone calls on the report, 20 minutes each. I told Hanna I would be available, and I can't be now. One call is with a trade newsletter and the other with a Belgian daily. If you feel ready, take them yourself and open with the corrected figure, so they don't find it first. If you'd rather not, ask Hanna to move them to after the launch. Either is fine, but please don't let anyone leave those calls still thinking the number is 2.1.

5. Prepare for the panel. Florian Kessler from the Alliance of European Steel Users will go for the 80% pass-through assumption in section 4. Don't let him set the tone. Be open about it: 80% is the central case. The annex B runs test 40% and 60%. The result holds at 60% and weakens at 40%. Don't get defensive. On resource shuffling he has a point, and we agree it's a risk. It is covered in section 5.2, and we recommend the Commission's monitoring report. His written comments from 12 November are in the folder. Abena Owusu-Mensah from the Accra Trade Policy Centre is joining remotely. Her link is in the calendar invite, and she tested it yesterday. She will probably back us on the LDC side. Ask Tomás for a dial-in backup in case the link fails.

6. Thursday itself. Guests need to be at the security entrance by 12:00, and the lunch is outside the room from 12:00. Lindqvist welcomes everyone at 12:30. Don't rush the presentation, even with the shorter slot.

7. After the event. Lucy Tran at the Halvorsen Foundation is attending with a colleague. She needs two photos from the event and the attendance numbers for their grant report by 4 December. Please get the numbers from Tomás and the photos from whoever is taking them in the room.

On reaching me: you can call, but after 9 tomorrow morning I may not pick up. A message is better, and I'll reply when I can. Please don't hold back on any decision waiting for me. You have the judgement for these calls, and I trust it.

Last thing. In Lisbon you rescued my panel when the projector died, and you were brilliant. You are better live than you think. I'm sorry I won't be in the room on Thursday, and thank you for doing this.

Marieke
